name: Youth Leadership Award and Scholarship
what_you_do: Apply for a $2,000 scholarship. It goes to one high school senior who shows leadership and will go on to higher education. The award honors young people who lead with courage, fairness and service.
who_can_apply: One high school senior who lives inside School District U-46 lines. You show leadership. You plan to go to college or higher education.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. The 2026 winner was to be announced at the Leader Luncheon on May 14, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Submit the scholarship application and essays when the call opens. The page lists writing help resources, and in 2026 offered free one-on-one feedback on up to two drafts.
notes: Recent winners came from Larkin, Bartlett and Elgin high schools. Contact YWCA Elgin at 847-742-7930 or info@ywcaelgin.org.
